cohort: The study included 108 twin pregnancies at a tertiary care hospital in Jamnagar, India, between July 2023 and April 2024.
finding: The most common obstetric complication observed in twin pregnancies was preterm labor (64.28%).
mod_finding: 52% of twin pregnancies resulted in vaginal delivery, while 48% required Caesarean sections, with malpresentation being the leading indication for C-section (50%).
